resources.string: Play your PC games on your phone
The game runs on your computer, and you control it from your phone.
Play with touch, or connect a gamepad to your phone.
Your PC does the heavy lifting
Your phone just shows the picture and passes on your input.
You connect your phone and PC once, with a PIN.
Through Tailscale, without opening ports on your router.
Setup takes a few minutes. Have your Windows PC at hand.
What do you usually play with?
We will set up the on-screen buttons to match.
You can change this in Settings.
On-screen buttons: A, B, X, Y.
On-screen buttons: cross, circle, square, triangle.
On-screen buttons hide when you connect the gamepad.
On-screen keys and mouse, like at a computer.
Sunshine is a free program that sends the picture from your PC to your phone. You get it from GitHub.

string-array.name: ui_onboarding_prepare_points
string-array.item: Tap “Send yourself the link” (by email, for example) and open the link on your PC.
GitHub opens. It is a site where free programs are published. You don\'t need an account.
Scroll down to the Assets section (the list of files). If the list is shortened, click “Show all … assets”.
Click the file `Sunshine-Windows-AMD64-installer.msi`. Can\'t see it? Press Ctrl+F and type `installer.msi`.
Open the downloaded file (Downloads folder) and keep clicking Next. When Windows asks for permission, choose Yes.
On the PC, open `https://localhost:47990` in a browser.
The browser warns that the connection is not private. That is normal: click Advanced and continue to localhost.
Set a Sunshine username and password. Write them down.

resources.string: Send the link by email or a messenger, for example, and open it on your PC.
ViGEmBus is the driver you need to play with a gamepad. With it, games on your PC see your phone as a regular Xbox gamepad.

string-array.name: ui_onboarding_driver_points
string-array.item: Tap “Send yourself the link” and open it on your PC. This is a GitHub page too.
At the top you will see a yellow note that the project is archived. That is normal: the driver is finished and works.
In the Assets section, click the file `ViGEmBus_1.22.0_x64_x86_arm64.exe`.
Run the downloaded file and go through the installation. When Windows asks for permission, choose Yes.
Restart the PC if the installer asks you to.
In Sunshine (`https://localhost:47990`), open Configuration → Input, pick the Xbox 360 gamepad (`x360`) and save.

resources.string: There are also paid alternatives, such as LizardByte Virtual HID Driver. ViGEmBus is all you need to play.
You will do this on the computer list, right after setup.

string-array.name: ui_onboarding_connect_points
string-array.item: Connect your phone to the same Wi-Fi as your PC.
Pick your PC on the computer list.
Your phone shows a PIN. On the PC, open `https://localhost:47990`, go to the PIN tab, and enter the code.

resources.string: Don\'t see your PC on the list? You can add it by its IP address.
These instructions are always at hand: “How to connect a PC” on the home screen and in Settings → Help.
No app can open this. The address was copied to the clipboard.
Download Sunshine for your PC. On the page, scroll to the Assets section and click Sunshine-Windows-AMD64-installer.msi:
Download the ViGEmBus gamepad driver. On the page, in the Assets section, click ViGEmBus_1.22.0_x64_x86_arm64.exe:
Download Tailscale for your PC and sign in with the same account as on your phone:
You only do this once, on a Windows PC. Tick off the parts you have finished.
Sunshine is a free program that sends the picture from your PC to your phone.

string-array.name: ui_guide_install_steps
string-array.item: On the PC, open the download page (buttons below). It is GitHub: free programs are published there, and you don\'t need an account.
The page shows the newest Sunshine version. Scroll down to the Assets section (the list of files). If the list is shortened, click “Show all … assets”.
Click `Sunshine-Windows-AMD64-installer.msi` to download it. Can\'t see it? Press Ctrl+F and type `installer.msi`.
Open the downloaded file (Downloads folder) and keep clicking Next. When Windows asks for permission, choose Yes. Sunshine adds its Windows service and firewall rules on its own.
On the PC, open `https://localhost:47990` in a browser.
The browser warns that the connection is not private. That is normal with Sunshine: click Advanced and continue to localhost.
Set an admin username and password. Remember them.

resources.string: PC with an ARM processor (such as Snapdragon)? Pick `Sunshine-Windows-ARM64-installer.msi`.
Thumbcast also works with Apollo and Vibepollo (Sunshine variants), but this guide covers Sunshine.
The driver you need to play with a gamepad: with it, games on your PC see the gamepad from your phone as a regular Xbox gamepad. Without it, only mouse and keyboard work.

string-array.name: ui_guide_gamepad_steps
string-array.item: On the PC, open the ViGEmBus download page (buttons below). It is GitHub too.
At the top you will see a yellow note that the project is archived. That is normal: the driver is finished and works.
In the Assets section, click `ViGEmBus_1.22.0_x64_x86_arm64.exe`.
Run the downloaded file and go through the installation. When Windows asks for permission, choose Yes.
Restart the PC if the installer asks you to.
In Sunshine (`https://localhost:47990`), open Configuration → Input and pick the Xbox 360 gamepad (`gamepad = x360`). Save and restart Sunshine.

resources.string: There are also paid alternatives, such as LizardByte Virtual HID Driver (more gamepad types; you enter the license in Sunshine). ViGEmBus is all you need to play.
Without a driver, only Mouse and keyboard (MMO) controls work.
Pair your phone with the PC

string-array.name: ui_guide_pair_steps
string-array.item: Connect your phone to the same network as the PC (the same Wi-Fi at home).
In Thumbcast, pick your PC on the list. Your phone shows a PIN.
On the PC, open `https://localhost:47990`, go to the PIN tab and enter the code from your phone.
You pair only once. After that, just pick the PC on the list.
PC not on the list? Add it by its IP address (for example `192.168.1.20`).

string-array.name: ui_guide_apps_steps
string-array.item: In Sunshine, open the Applications tab and choose Add New.
Example, Steam Big Picture: in Detached Commands enter `steam://open/bigpicture`.
Put games started by a launcher (Steam, Battle.net) in Detached Commands, and a regular program in Command.
Set resolution and controls for one game in Thumbcast: long-press the game on the list → Game settings.
Want the PC to switch its resolution too? In Sunshine: Configuration → Audio/Video → Device configuration (`verify_only`).

A game started by a launcher (Battle.net, Steam) does not close on its own after “Close the game on the PC”, because Sunshine did not start it. In Sunshine, in that game: Command Preparations → Add, and in Undo enter `taskkill /IM GameName.exe` (file name from Task Manager → Details). Game still running? Add `/F`.

resources.string: Tailscale connects your phone to your PC over the internet, without opening ports.

string-array.name: ui_guide_remote_steps
string-array.item: Install Tailscale on the PC and on your phone. Sign in to the same account on both.
Pair your phone with the PC at home (part 3).
On the list, long-press the PC → Connection addresses → Add address. Enter the PC\'s Tailscale address (`100.x.y.z`).
At home Thumbcast still connects over Wi-Fi; away from home it uses Tailscale.
Don\'t forward ports on your router. Tailscale is enough.

string-array.name: ui_guide_troubleshoot_steps
string-array.item: PC not on the list: check that your phone and PC are on the same network and that Windows Firewall does not block Sunshine. You can also add the PC by its IP address.
Gamepad does not work in the game: install the gamepad driver (part 2) and restart Sunshine.
Video stutters: lower Image quality in Settings. Away from home, choose 720p.
Can\'t connect away from home: check that Tailscale is on, on both the PC and your phone.
The game stays open on the PC after “Close the game on the PC”: set a close command in Sunshine (part 4).
